scenario: An iPhone 13 Pro owner wants convenient overnight charging at a desk and bedside plus a magnetic charger in the car. They are considering buying several units at once and are comparing a Vchiming dual pad, a magnetic car mount, and a THREEKEY magnetic pad with a bundled adapter. They care more about verified delivered power, wall-energy use, temperature behavior, and credible long-term evidence than a printed 15 W maximum, and they will run one bounded trial before a multi-location rollout if the frozen evidence does not establish the broader claim.
target: Audit the complete frozen Vchiming dual-pad, magnetic car-mount, and THREEKEY pad bodies; the inductive-transfer, Qi power-control, charger-control, and lithium-ion boundaries; and the almost-year wireless-use, camera-gap, temperature-stop, and wired-versus-wireless discussions. Recommend one route or defer while preserving exact price, rating, form, adapter, device-profile, alignment, efficiency, heat, owner-scope, and missing product-specific long-term evidence boundaries, then specify a bounded preflight for any conditional pilot.
